events.title: YOU'RE DECLARING
lines: Next stop: the draft combine. Scouts will measure your height, wingspan, reach, vertical and lane agility.
Then draft night: where you go decides your first club and your rookie contract.

lines: Agent Rhea Ekwueme wants to represent you.
"I get you 10% more on every contract you sign, your rookie deal included. I take 4% of your salary."
Scouts have you at #39 in the mock draft.
Or go it alone and keep every dollar of a smaller deal.
